title: A continuation whose producer held grants it lacks drops the carried files, withholds the seed and says so
note: A narrower ceiling between steps cannot be made through the product in this world (the grantor is one platform admin), so sh/narrow-producer-grants.sh simulates it: it deletes the frozen exportGrants from the first run's staged_inputs, and a producer with no readable grants is NOT covered (analysisContinuation.ts producerGrantsCovered fails closed). That exercises the real drop path (reason grants_not_covered, seed withheld), but by a database edit, not by a real permission change; the dataset-by-dataset comparison is covered by unit tests, not here. The reply check is the open part: whether the chat model is told about the drop at all is a product question, so a red reply check with green SQL checks means the model was not told, not that the drop failed. Local throwaway stack only.

steps.name: launch
steps.text: Start an analysis across the whole Northwind Dental organization. Export the device inventory and write a file named nw_inventory_summary.csv with one row per device: hostname, operating system and last seen time.

steps.name: root-settled
steps.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from ai_agent_runs where profile = 'analysis' and chain_depth = 0 and queued_at > {{since}} and status in ('completed','failed','cancelled')

steps.name: continue1
steps.text: Build on that analysis: from nw_inventory_summary.csv, count the devices per operating system. Tell me plainly if you could not use the earlier file or its findings.

steps.name: step2-settled
steps.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from ai_agent_runs where profile = 'analysis' and chain_depth = 1 and queued_at > {{since}} and status in ('completed','failed','cancelled')

steps.name: final
steps.text: Did the second step get to use the first step's file and findings?

checks.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from ai_run_artifacts a join ai_agent_runs r on r.id = a.run_id where r.profile = 'analysis' and r.chain_depth = 0 and r.queued_at > {{since}} and a.kind = 'output' and a.name = 'nw_inventory_summary.csv'
checks.note: the first run produced a file that could have been carried

checks.sql: select (coalesce(trigger_ref->'continuation'->'dropped' @> '[{"reason":"grants_not_covered"}]'::jsonb, false))::text from ai_agent_runs where profile = 'analysis' and chain_depth = 1 and queued_at > {{since}} order by queued_at limit 1
checks.note: the carried file was dropped for grants_not_covered

checks.sql: select (count(*) = 0)::text from ai_agent_runs r2 join ai_run_artifacts a on a.run_id = r2.chain_root_run_id where r2.profile = 'analysis' and r2.chain_depth = 1 and r2.queued_at > {{since}} and a.kind = 'output' and a.name = 'nw_inventory_summary.csv' and jsonb_exists(coalesce(r2.staged_inputs->'handles', '[]'::jsonb), a.id::text)
checks.note: the first run's file is not among the continuation's staged handles

checks.sql: select (coalesce(trigger_ref->'continuation'->>'seed', '') like '%summary and findings are not included%')::text from ai_agent_runs where profile = 'analysis' and chain_depth = 1 and queued_at > {{since}} order by queued_at limit 1
checks.note: the seed keeps only the goal and the fixed withheld line
the model says the earlier file or findings were not available to the second step
